name: Xiamen XGMA Machinery Company Limited
summary: Xiamen XGMA Machinery Company Limited research, develops, produces, and sells engineering machinery products and core components in China, Southeast and Central Asia, Eastern Europe, South America, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers wheel, backhoe, excavators, and skid steel loaders; downhole machines; tracked and wheeled excavators; and steel grabbers.
